messages:
Devin: Heads up — found a broken link in the internal API docs (customer-routing section). Landing page points to an old RFC that was archived.

Devin: link: https://docs.redwood.ai/platform/customer-routing -> redirects to 404

Devin: can someone from docs own a quick fix? Looks like the intended target is /rfc/customer-routing-v2.

Maria: @Devin thanks for catching. I'll take ownership. :+1:

Maria: Quick question — do we want to keep a redirect or update the doc to point to the new RFC?

Elaine: I'd prefer updating the link and adding a short note about the archive. Redirects are ok but messy long-term.

Maria: Agreed. I'll open a small PR. Draft diff:
```
- [Customer routing](https://docs.redwood.ai/platform/customer-routing)
+ [Customer routing](https://docs.redwood.ai/rfc/customer-routing-v2)  // added note about archive
```

Maria: Ping @docs for review

DocsBot: New doc issue created: DOCS-4821 — Update customer routing link (assigned to Maria)

Sam: @Maria FYI: double-check sidebar toc — it references `platform/index.md` which might need a tweak.

Maria: Good call, I'll update the toc in the same PR.

Elaine: If you can, add a unit test link-checker update (one-liner) so this fails CI if link dies again.

Maria: Will do. Adding a quick `scripts/link-check --update-exceptions` entry.

Devin: Thanks all. Leaving this thread here in case anything blocks the rollout. :raised_hands:
